Export a chord diagram

save_chord.Rd

Save a chord diagram and its label mapping. HTML includes zoom controls and a searchable, clickable sector legend. PDF legends continue on separate pages.

Usage

save_chord(x, file = "microfun_chord.html", width = 18, height = 16,
  formats = NULL, ...)

Arguments

x

A microfun_chord object.

file

Output path ending in pdf, png, svg, html or rds; defaults to microfun_chord.html.

formats

Optional additional formats to save alongside the primary output: html, pdf, png, svg, rds.

width,height

Figure dimensions in inches.

...

Graphical arguments passed to the chord renderer; see tax2fun_chord.

Details

HTML uses a separate legend panel. Selecting an entry highlights its sector, including sectors with hidden labels. Labels that do not fit are omitted from the chart, and their aliases are omitted from static legends. PNG and SVG write a companion legend PDF when necessary. Rendered exports write a label mapping CSV. RDS stores the chord object without rendering.

Value

Invisibly, the normalized output path or named vector of paths for multi-format export.

See also

tax2fun_chord
